positions.title: Principal Engineer - Team Lead
positions.description:
Principal Engineer on the Automated Trading Products team. The Automated Trading Products team delivers Trading Technologies' suite of high-performance low-latency products. These products include Autospreader®, ADL®, Algo Strategy Engine, Synthetic Strategy Engine (SSE), and Autotrader™. 

- Contributed to the design, implementation, and support of TT's automated trading products.
- Principal author of synthetic orders in TT's upcoming next-generation trading platform.
- Designed and implemented several key features in SSE, including automatic monitoring and re-planning of time sliced orders, enhancements for staged orders, and advanced support for user actions.
- Identified performance bottlenecks in critical paths in both SSE and AlgoSE. Elimination of these bottlenecks resulted in significant performance gains, in some cases reducing execution times by ~90%.
- Enhanced automatic code generation occurring in the Algo Strategy Engine.
- Successfully migrated Strategy Engine server products to new messaging protocol while maintaining backwards compatibility with previously released client products.
- Filed several electronic trading related patents.

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
Worked on DirectX/Direct3D (v9 and v10) driver development for Windows XP and Windows Vista.  Additionally, worked on DirectX/Direct3D development for the GeForce 8800 (G80), released November, 2006.

These DirectX drivers are used by both discrete and integrated NVIDIA graphics cards.
